title: S123 17.1.1.3 Construction of the ACK Request
parent_path: S123 17.1.1.3 Construction of the ACK Request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A UAC core that generates an ACK for 2xx MUST instead follow the rules described in Section 13.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The ACK request constructed by the client transaction MUST contain values for the Call-ID, From, and Request-URI that are equal to the values of those header fields in the request passed to the transport by the client transaction (call this the "original request").
statements.post_cond: ACK.Call-ID = original_request.Call-ID & ACK.From = original_request.From & ACK.Request-URI = original_request.Request-URI

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The To header field in the ACK MUST equal the To header field in the response being acknowledged, and therefore will usually differ from the To header field in the original request by the addition of the tag parameter.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The ACK MUST contain a single Via header field, and this MUST be equal to the top Via header field of the original request.
actions: include exactly one Via header field in ACK

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The CSeq header field in the ACK MUST contain the same value for the sequence number as was present in the original request, but the method parameter MUST be equal to "ACK".

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the INVITE request whose response is being acknowledged had Route header fields, those header fields MUST appear in the ACK.
actions: copy Route header fields from original INVITE into ACK

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Although any request MAY contain a body, a body in an ACK is special since the request cannot be rejected if the body is not understood.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Therefore, placement of bodies in ACK for non-2xx is NOT RECOMMENDED, but if done, the body types are restricted to any that appeared in the INVITE, assuming that the response to the INVITE was not 415.
statements.trigger: construct ACK request for non-2xx response
actions: if body is included: restrict ACK body types to those that appeared in original INVITE

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If it was, the body in the ACK MAY be any type listed in the Accept header field in the 415.
actions: permit ACK body type from 415_response.Accept header field values
